status: Source Study; All New CWI Applications Are Proposals

scope.source_inspection_scope: Selected mechanics, configuration and behavior. Not an exhaustive read of every block, map or source line.

version_boundary.source_file_verification: All retained Java fingerprints were checked against Git blob IDs in the release source tree.
version_boundary.wiki_provenance_qualification: Repository revision and fetched page hashes identify the reviewed evidence; repository HEAD alone does not prove deployed autogenerated page provenance.

qualifications: Generated wiki statistics are nominal and sometimes rounded; no practical layout rate or enjoyable pacing was measured.
Planet pages are sparse and logic manual incomplete; selected campaign and behavior claims were checked in official source.
No assumption that every listed block is normally reachable in every planet campaign; World Processor is privileged mapmaking content.
Ammunition demand requires firing, unit production can stop at caps, and research is finite.
Research pools eligible same-tree planet sector stocks, excludes frozen sectors and supports partial spending; this differs from Factorio continuous laboratory research.
Produce objectives test content unlock state and do not prove sustained automated output. CWI item tasks likewise do not prove an operating factory.
At v160.7 carbide and surge crucibles use 40 heat as full-efficiency target, permit partial-heat operation and cap thermal efficiency at 100%. Generic HeatCrafter permits other caps.
Terrain affinity placeholders in generated pages do not provide exact map placement bonuses; source establishes attribute-dependent behavior.
Mindustry ore overlays are not depleted by ordinary drills; CWI breakable ores/deposits have a different exploration role.

Current campaign turn update accumulates stored mean production for eligible unplayed peaceful sectors, caps storage and skips attacked sectors. This is not continuous Minecraft chunk simulation or evidence of closed-application production.
Advanced oil-consuming launch pads, water-consuming landing pads and legacy launch pads coexist in documentation; Serpulo permits legacy mode.
Serpulo startSector 170 is not a named sector preset; its default/interplanetary entry role does not prove it replaces an authored tutorial.
Sector unlocked() behavior was not inferred from its stale adjacency comment.
CWI RPM, stress capacity, discrete heat eligibility and temperature modifiers are distinct from Mindustry electrical and heat models.
Packages/frogports, schematics and proposed control layouts are analogies requiring CWI tests, especially custom MBD state and early hardware access.
Mindustry recipes and abstract heat units are not chemical or engineering authorities for CWI realism.

silicon.qualification: Excludes terrain effects and the costs of upstream pyratite and other services.

impact_reactor.qualification: Full operation; direct net excludes upstream fuel/coolant production and does not establish startup supply.

crucible_heat.qualification: Carbide and surge crucibles at v160.7, with other operating conditions satisfied.

cwi_glass_recovery.qualification: Lossy recovery; retained soda/limestone return remains an intentional gameplay simplification.

cwi_constraints: Refine existing early chapters before expanding the unfinished Electrical Age.
Quests inform and record progress; they must not gate recipes.
Steel stays in the blast furnace. Air supplies first steel; oxygen is a later upgrade. Avoid steel-dependent bootstrap machinery.
Keep returned glass soda/limestone and other accepted gameplay abstractions.
Keep removed Fermento, Carbofusor and Putrelys revival routes removed.
Do not reopen accepted client/RNS concerns or deferred hammer, loot-roll, crafting-grid and lava edge cases.
Keep factual materials/geography references, practical manuals and uncertain narrative records appropriate to their roles.
New restoration mechanics, new hazards, shared heat networks and automatic commissioning detection remain unimplemented proposals.
